in_marathi.name: Tvesa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tvesa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tvesa is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Tushta', which means 'content' or 'satisfied'. In Hindu mythology, Tvesa is the goddess of abundance and prosperity. She is often depicted as holding a lotus in her hand, symbolizing wealth and purity.
